CC.notes: Common Core wording is the default and what every item is written in. A state entry lists only what differs: phrase -> replacement, whole phrases only. Reserved keys in a state entry: notes, gradeLimits (phrase -> grades the swap applies to, K..5), money (how amounts are written).

TX.notes: TEKS / STAAR: 'strip diagram' for tape diagram at every grade. 'number sentence' for equation in K-2 only; from grade 3 STAAR says 'equation'. Grade 3 says 'expanded notation' for expanded form (not swapped yet — grade 3 only, and 'expanded form' is also used; add it here once confirmed against released items). 'number line' stays.

VA.notes: Virginia SOL: 'number sentence' for equation in K-2; 'equation' from grade 3. Diagram terms not confirmed yet.

money.notes: From grade 2, money is written with $ and a decimal ($0.45), never with a cent sign (45¢).

FL.notes: Florida B.E.S.T. keeps the Common Core terms; the difference is money notation (see money).
